newsitem.title: USA: Clinton, a southern Baptist, won't boycott Disney.
newsitem.headline: Clinton, a southern Baptist, won't boycott Disney.

text.p: One Southern Baptist won't be joining in the boycott of Walt Disney Co. called by church leaders -- U.S President Bill Clinton.

Clinton, a self-described "Scotch-Irish Southern Baptist", was asked Thursday whether he planned to abide by the boycott called by the Southern Baptist Convention, which has accused the movie, television and theme park group of promoting homosexuality.
He replied with a single word: "No."

The president answered the question before a meeting with Japanese Prime Minister Ryutaro Hashimoto ahead of the annual summit of the Group of Seven leading industrial nations starting Friday in Denver.

Disney has angered Southern Baptists and other religous conservatives because of it has extended health benefits to partners of homosexuals and allowed "gay days" organised by gay rights groups at its theme parks.
The Southern Baptists, meeting in Dallas on Wednesday, called for a boycott of Disney and its subsidiaries, which include ABC television and radio.
